name: Default
shortDescription: Anti-detection headless browser server for AI agents, built on Camoufox and controlled through a REST API with accessibility snapshots and element refs.

alerts.message: Every request except /health, including the /docs page, needs an Authorization: Bearer header with the generated CAMOFOX_ACCESS_KEY from the environment settings. Cookie import uses CAMOFOX_API_KEY and POST /stop uses CAMOFOX_ADMIN_KEY in the X-Admin-Key header.
